# ── About ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

> Julian Johnson is the founder of Unified Solutions Inc. Direct executive and team coach for leaders and groups who need **movement, not theater**. ICF PCC and ACTC. Over 1,500 coaching hours with 250+ senior leaders and founders, globally. Faculty at ExecOnline and Emeritus. Seventeen years developing business and interpersonal acumen while leading teams inside Fortune 500 transformations.

> He works where organizations are already investing: **leader and manager development**, **change management and workforce resiliency**, and the human side of **HR tech and AI strategy**. With leaders, teams, and cohorts he pushes past theory into application: problem and solution statements, decision quality, operating metrics, risk and gaps, work that holds under customer, peer, and sponsor pressure.

> **Positioning:** Whole-Person Catalyst is the method, not a soft category. Read the room, challenge what is avoided, create movement. The leader carrying the P&L is the same human carrying the weight underneath it. Decision quality and execution are the point.

# ── Services ────────────────────────────────────────────────

## 1:1 Executive Coaching
For senior leaders in large systems when a seat is changing, or the work is moving faster than they can adopt it. Direct engagements from $400/hr. Typical $500/hr. Three-month minimum. Keep at the margin of the practice when platform volume is team/group.

## Team Coaching
ICF ACTC-level team coaching. Intact leadership teams. Adoption in an honest room, not a stack of 1:1s. 60–90 days. Typical $10,000–$15,000.

## Group Coaching
Cohorts that stop performing the learning. Same craft used in university-partnered rooms with senior leaders from large systems. Typical $8,000–$12,000 per cohort.

## Succession Circle
A peer room for leaders who are leaving a way of working, or stepping into one. Who they are going in, what they leave, who they are after. Not the search. Not the org chart. From $500/month per member. Already held with executive directors and presidents of national mission-driven organizations.
